# The Translation Dictionary

| SAS Operation | R (`dplyr`) |
|---------------|-------------|
| `KEEP`/`DROP` | `select()` |
| `WHERE` | `filter()` |
| `IF ... THEN ...` | `mutate()` + `if_else()`/`case_when()` |
| `BY` | `group_by()` |
| `PROC SORT` | `arrange()` |
| `RENAME` | `rename()` |
| `PROC MEANS/FREQ` | `summarise()` |

# The Pipe (`%>%` or `|>`)

The pipe passes the result of the left side to the first argument of the right side. It lets you read code from left-to-right, top-to-bottom.

```r
# "Take dataset `dm`, THEN filter rows, THEN select columns"
dm_clean <- dm %>%
  filter(ARM != "Screen Failure") %>%
  select(USUBJID, ARM, AGE, SEX)
```

# Row Operations

## Filter (WHERE)

```r
# numeric condition
filter(dm, AGE >= 18)

# string condition
filter(dm, ARM == "Placebo")

# multiple conditions (AND)
filter(dm, AGE >= 18, SEX == "F")

# OR condition
filter(dm, ARM == "Placebo" | ARM == "Active")
```

## Arrange (PROC SORT)

```r
# Ascending
arrange(dm, USUBJID)

# Descending
arrange(dm, desc(AGE))
```

# Column Operations

## Select (KEEP/DROP)

```r
# Keep specific columns
select(dm, USUBJID, AGE)

# Drop columns
select(dm, -RFSTDTC)

# Select helper functions
select(dm, starts_with("AE"))
```

## Mutate (Variable Creation)

```r
dm_new <- dm %>%
  mutate(
    # Simple arithmetic
    AGE_MONTHS = AGE * 12,
    
    # Conditional logic (if/else)
    AGE_GROUP = if_else(AGE >= 65, "Elderly", "Adult"),
    
    # Complex logic (CASE statement)
    BMI_CAT = case_when(
      BMI < 18.5 ~ "Underweight",
      BMI < 25 ~ "Normal",
      BMI < 30 ~ "Overweight",
      TRUE ~ "Obese" # The "Else" clause
    )
  )
```

# Aggregation (PROC MEANS/FREQ)

Split-Apply-Combine strategy.

```r
dm %>%
  group_by(ARM) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Mean_Age = mean(AGE, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Age = sd(AGE, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
